title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
job_description:
Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in mobile app development (iOS & Android) Strong experience in React Native or Flutter for cross-platform mobile development Backend development experience with Node.js / Express / NestJS or similar frameworks Database experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or Firebase Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services Familiar with Git version control At least one live app published on Google Play Store and/or Apple App Store Good communication skills in English and/or Bahasa Malaysia Able to work onsite in Sungai Petani, Kedah

Build, develop and maintain Lovia's mobile application for both iOS and Android platforms Design and implement backend APIs, services and databases to support app features Integrate third-party services , payment systems and external APIs into the application Ensure app performance, security and scalability across all supported devices Debug, troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across the full stack Manage and deploy app releases to Google Play Store and Apple App Store Write clean, well-structured and properly documented code Collaborate directly with the founder and product team on feature development and product decisions

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave EPF SOCSO EIS Annual Bonus Medical Insurance 5 Working Days Flexible Working Hours Work from Home Company Trip

Mobile Development Full Stack Development iOS Development Android Development API Integration JavaScript React Native Node.js Database Management Agile Methodologies
